name: 🔥 Steal a Critter 🦆
description:
🔥 STEAL rare critters from other players' bases and build the richest critter empire!

✅ Never lose everything: THEFT INSURANCE pays you back 25% + 90s REVENGE to steal it back instantly
⭐ FUSE 3 identical critters into a stronger ★ critter (up to ★★★)
🌈 Find GOLDEN, DIAMOND and RAINBOW mutations (up to x10 cash)
🎉 FREE server events every 8 minutes for everyone: Golden Hour, Critter Rush, Lucky Belt, Double Cash
👫 Play with friends: +10% cash per friend in your server
💌 Invite friends: you BOTH get cash and you earn +5% income forever
📅 Daily rewards with streak bonus
🛡️ Slap thieves, lock your base, rebirth for huge multipliers
👑 Active players earn community ranks

Can you get a Rainbow ★★★ Mythic?
